name: Pneumatic ATC
author: ncSender
description: Pneumatic automatic tool changer workflow helper. Uses a single aux output to clamp/unclamp the collet.

PRESSURE_FAULT.title: Air Pressure Low
PRESSURE_FAULT.message: Air pressure is too low for the drawbar. Fix the air supply, then Re-check or Abort.

PRESSURE_FAULT_UNVERIFIED.title: Air Pressure Still Low
PRESSURE_FAULT_UNVERIFIED.message: Pressure still low after 2 rechecks. Continuing is unverified and risky. Abort is safest.

DRAWBAR_FAULT.title: Drawbar Not Released
DRAWBAR_FAULT.message: Drawbar sensor doesn't show released. Clear any obstruction, then Re-check or Abort.

DRAWBAR_FAULT_UNVERIFIED.title: Drawbar Still Not Released
DRAWBAR_FAULT_UNVERIFIED.message: Drawbar still not released after 2 rechecks. Continuing is unverified and risky.

TOOL_FAULT.title: Tool Not Seated
TOOL_FAULT.message: Tool-seated sensor doesn't show seated. Check the tool, then Re-check or Abort.

TOOL_FAULT_UNVERIFIED.title: Tool Still Not Seated
TOOL_FAULT_UNVERIFIED.message: Tool still not seated after 2 rechecks. Continuing is unverified and risky.

RACK_SLOT_EMPTY.title: Rack Slot Empty
RACK_SLOT_EMPTY.message: Rack slot for tool {toolNumber} appears empty. Switching to manual load.

UNEXPECTED_TOOL_DETECTED.title: Unexpected Tool
UNEXPECTED_TOOL_DETECTED.message: A tool is unexpectedly seated. Click Release, remove it by hand, then Continue.

FAILED_UNLOAD_TOOL.title: Unload Failed
FAILED_UNLOAD_TOOL.message: Failed to unload {toolNumber}. Remove it by hand, then Continue or Abort.

FAILED_LOAD_TOOL.title: Load Failed
FAILED_LOAD_TOOL.message: Failed to load {toolNumber}. Install it by hand, then Continue or Abort.

MANUAL_UNLOAD_TOOL.title: Manual Unload
MANUAL_UNLOAD_TOOL.message: Click Release to open the drawbar, remove tool {toolNumber}, then Continue or Abort.

MANUAL_LOAD_TOOL.title: Manual Load
MANUAL_LOAD_TOOL.message: Click Release, insert tool {toolNumber}, click Clamp, then Continue.

MANUAL_CLAMP_TOOL.title: Manual Load
MANUAL_CLAMP_TOOL.message: Insert tool {toolNumber}, click Clamp to close the drawbar, then Continue.

MANUAL_SWAP_TOOL.title: Manual Swap
MANUAL_SWAP_TOOL.message: Click Release, swap in tool {toolNumber}, click Clamp, then Continue.
